Name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information Security Management for OCI
Description: International standard for Information Security Management Systems (ISMS) across OCI cloud governance domains.

Requirements.Name: Access Control & IAM Governance
Requirements.Description: Access to OCI resources must be restricted in accordance with the established topic-specific policy on access control.

Requirements.Name: Authentication Information and Password Policies
Requirements.Description: Enforce minimum length of 14 characters, password expiration within 365 days, and prevent password reuse in OCI IAM.

Requirements.Name: User Endpoint and Instance Security
Requirements.Description: Ensure compute instances enforce secure boot, disable legacy metadata endpoints (IMDSv1), and enable in-transit encryption.

Requirements.Name: Network Security & Segregation
Requirements.Description: Network security controls must protect information in networks and its supporting information processing facilities.

Requirements.Name: Use of Cryptography & Key Management
Requirements.Description: Cryptographic controls and KMS key rotation must be utilized to protect sensitive data at rest and in transit.

Requirements.Name: Logging & Monitoring
Requirements.Description: Audit logs recording user activities, exceptions, faults and information security events must be retained for 365 days.
